quests.title: Troublesome Work

dialogue.t: *yawn* If you're borrowing a book, please register it in the log. The restricted section is currently not lending any books...
Oh? It's you, little cutie.
It's so good to see you! More refreshing than a strong cup of tea in the afternoon.
Clearly you're meant to be working, but you don't seem to have your heart in it at all...
I mean, other than Jean, who really works that earnestly anyway?

dialogue.sit: I do feel sorry for Jean always working so hard...

dialogue.t: So did you have something you needed?
...Or did you just come to see me?

dialogue.sit: I just wanted to see you!
Ah... No, I don't think I had anything specific in mind...

dialogue.t: Ooh, a smooth talker. Not what I was expecting.
So Miss Librarian, got any books to recommend?
Hmm... Recommended books... Sadly, everything I'd personally recommend is all in the restricted section, which we're not currently lending out.
What's with her ominous tone?
Oh, right. Would you be interested in checking out the <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color>?
I think it would be quite helpful for you as travelers here.
Ooh! Sounds like it could be helpful!
Do you think we could take a peek?
I suppose I can try to find you a copy from the list...
Isn't this Lisa's job? What does she mean "I suppose..."?
Oh dear... That's unfortunate. Our copy is currently being borrowed. That said, it is now overdue...
Come to think of it, quite a few of our books are now overdue. I REALLY wish people would just return their books...
...on time!
Whoa! Is Paimon imagining things, or does the air in here suddenly feel a lot more... electrified!?
It's giving me goosebumps!
Ugh... such a pain. I'm going out to bring those unreturned books back.
If you'd rather get your hands on that copy of the <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color> sooner, you'd better come with me.
Lisa seems really scary right now, Paimon thinks it would be best if you answer her...?
Oh, ah, yes... YES!
You really are such a considerate cutie. Let's see, first we can go to...
The <color=#00E1FFFF>souvenir shop</color>. It's called "With Wind Comes Glory." So let's meet there shortly.
Ah... No, I don't think I had anything specific in mind...
Nothing specific? You must just be here to see me then...
Hehe... Okay, I won't tease you any further.
I do feel sorry for Jean always working so hard...
{NICKNAME}, you're here! Let's begin, shall we?
Excuse me, Marjorie...
Marjorie, regarding the book you borrowed—
Hello Marjorie, any exciting new items in stock?
Why so surprised? Today is such a special day, it's only natural that I'd want a souvenir to remember it by.

dialogue.sit: Today is just an ordinary day...
What about the overdue library book?

dialogue.t: So it is... In that case, I declare this the "Day of..." the "Day of My Life I Wish I Could Get Back Because I Spent My First Ever Outing With {NICKNAME} Taking Them on an Annoying Errand."
Haha... Well, if it's a souvenir you're after, you're in the right place. I'm sure you'll find something that strikes your fancy, Lisa.
Or you could let your new friend pick something out for you... make it more of an occasion?
Yes, yes! Let {NICKNAME} pick!
Alright then.

Take a look around, there's sure to be something she'll love.
(Choose a gift for Lisa.)
What about the overdue library book?
Since we came all this way, why don't we put our official business to one side for a moment?
All work and no play makes life terribly mundane.
...So this is a date now?
Ooh. Is that how you see it?
I suppose there's nothing wrong with that... At your age, these kinds of fleeting fantasies are normal.

Take a look around, there's sure to be something she'll love.
(Choose a gift for Lisa.)
Bloomers
This pair? Soft, puffy, and very comfortable. Certain to make a little girl — well, in this case, a woman — look quite adorable.
After all, they're the same kind worn by toy dolls. They're practically a badge of cuteness.
Bloomers? I'm sure to attract some strange looks if I dress up like a small child in public. Do you have some strange... hobby you're not telling me about?
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>bloomers</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Ragged old scroll.
This is a historical relic retrieved from some ruins by one of the Adventurers' Guild.
Sure, there's a bit of wear and tear, but this thing in the painting must be well over a thousand years old... though it doesn't make much sense to me.
My goodness... This is one of the three lost scrolls that make up the "Northern Border Wind Investigation..." What is it doing here!?
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>ragged old scroll</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Maybe later.
Yes
*sigh* Well, if you insist... I will just use them as an extra pair of pajamas.
Yes
My my, you clearly know a treasure when you see it. This is a work of unparalleled significance for the research of ancient people's understanding of the elements. I will gladly accept it.
Yes
It is said that the gift of a voodoo doll is certain to curse its recipient. Although, magic of this level certainly wouldn't have any effect on me.
But you're probably innocent to such things. Since you're just a traveler, I will pretend that none of this ever happened.
Yes
I suppose it's not completely useless... I'll let Razor borrow it when it's time for his enhancement training.
No
No
Goodness, is that the time? Marjorie, one last thing — about "The Legend of Vennessa"—
Oh, so you're a fan of the gallant Lady Vennessa too? Why didn't you say so? I have all sorts of items I could recommend...
For example, this lion's tooth pendant with Vennessa's name carved into it. It was once a medal awarded to a knight by the great lady herself!
I think what Lisa means is...
The library book you borrowed.
Oh my goodness! I do apologize, I got so excited when you mentioned Vennessa.
I didn't know that book was overdue. Even though I take it with me everywhere...
I can't believe I didn't put two and two together as soon as I saw you here, haha... Here you go.
*sigh* Well, since you look up to Lady Vennessa so very much... Please be more punctual next time.
Yes, Lisa. I will be, Lisa.
Let's go and find the next overdue book.

Take a look around, there's sure to be something she'll love.
(Choose a gift for Lisa.)
Voodoo doll.
This is the toy doll I was talking about earlier — doesn't she look lovely in those shorts?
Hmm... It does look a little bit terrifying, doesn't it? I wonder if you could find some other use for it...
Voodoo doll? Have you lost your mind? What could I have possibly done to deserve this?
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>voodoo doll</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
What does Marjorie think?
Me? You're asking me? Erm... I feel like Lisa is the well-educated type.
Ah, that's right — I heard she enjoys <color=#00E1FFFF>items of historical interest</color>.
Rusty sword.
This is a new arrival. It took three Adventurers to carry this big boy back from the ruins where they found it.
It comes with a lot of history as well as a lot of weight.
Hmm... You do have strange tastes. If this is your way of saying you want to be my knight in shining armor, I'd rather you just say the words instead.
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>rusty sword</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Welcome to Good Hunter. Table for two?
THREE!
Oh, haha! My apologies... Please sit wherever you like and call me over once you're ready to order.
So we're gonna eat first and bring up the book situation later?
Why, of course. The stress of work really takes the pleasure out of eating, don't you think?
Work is that bad, huh?

*yawn*... Why don't you order us something, {NICKNAME}? I'm ever so curious to know what your tastes are.
(Pick a dish that Lisa will like)
Steak
Good Hunter's signature dish. If it's what you want, I'll try anything once.
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Steak</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Northern Smoked Chicken
This seems like the sort of staple bar food you'd find at the tavern. It has an extremely strong flavor, so drinkers love it because they can actually taste it.
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Northern Smoked Chicken</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Wait a moment...
Yes
Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.
Yes
Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.
No
Regarding Lisa's taste in food...
What does Lisa like to eat?
She's been here a few times with Master Jean for afternoon tea before. I think she normally orders <color=#00E1FFFF>something vegetarian</color>.
A lady tends to eat cautiously on account of her physique, after all! On that note, I should probably be watching my own diet a little more...
Oof... Paimon's so full...
Time is getting on. I suppose I should carry on with this ghastly thing called work.
Let's have a little chat with Sara about her library book.
Satisfying Salad
Eating salad is like piling on more and more elemental power. Raw, unfettered energy applied indiscriminately, with no elegance or control.

It's the first mistake all magic users make when they're learning. But then again... if one genuinely had so much pure elemental power that they could solve any problem they wanted... that would be a different matter entirely.
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Satisfying Salad</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Yes
Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.
Radish Veggie Soup
I imagine that making a good vegetable soup takes good quality ingredients cooked in the right order at the right heat for the right length of time.
At least, those are the principles that apply when one is making potions. But from what I've heard, soup-making was a popular pastime among the witches of the past.
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Radish Veggie Soup</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Yes
Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.
Invigorating Pizza
*gasp* It's like you read my mind... Do you have some magical powers you're not telling me about, Outlander?
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Invigorating Pizza</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Yes
Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.
Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.
Mm... beautifully tender and cooked to perfection. No wonder it's their signature dish. It's a shame I can't have more, but a witch must watch her physique.
Hmm, such a potent aroma... It's almost suffocating. I never thought someone your age would go for a dish like this...
I always had you down as a little cutie... Now I'm not so sure.
A fine choice! I'm pleasantly surprised.
A truly enchanting dish, certainly a good fit for a witch. I am simply brimming with elemental energy after that.
The ingredients are fresh — the Good Hunter certainly lives up to its reputation in that respect. Salad as a meal is a little bland, though — it always feels like there's something missing.
Wow, Jean must have given you some pointers? Such extraordinary lengths to prepare for a delicious meal... I'd almost say that's cheating.
I didn't know you and Jean got on so well. She used to make this for me once in a while too.
As it happens, this is exactly what I was craving — the perfect treat after a tiresome day of work. You've outdone yourself.
Would you like to order something else?
No thank you, we're quite satisfied. But I'm afraid I must ask you about "The Boar Princess"—
The Boar Brisket? I'm sorry, I think we took that off the menu.
She means the book you borrowed!
Oh! Of course! I came straight to the restaurant after I borrowed it and completely forgot that I even had it.
I'm so sorry Lisa, I will bring it to the library myself as soon as I finish work.
Mm... Okay then. But make sure you don't forget this time.
Right, onto our next stop then, {NICKNAME}.

Some flowers for Miss Lisa? What would you like?
(Pick a kind that Lisa will like)
Dandelion
Dandelions are one of our classics, and a personal favorite of Miss Flora, the shop owner.

I know what you're thinking: Most flower shops don't sell dandelions, they're a nuisance to care for... Perhaps Miss Flora likes the sense of floating away to a faraway land that the dandelion evokes?
Come to think of it, Miss Flora herself gives people the same impression.
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Dandelion</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Mist Flower
Mist Flowers? Over there in the corner... but don't touch them with your bare hands. You'll get frostbite.
You want them? You're sure? What an unusual choice...
It's just that Lisa seems to use Electro quite a lot. Things could get a little bit dangerous...
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Mist Flower</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Rose
These roses were bought from a traveling merchant a few days ago.
Miss Flora thought maybe someone would like them... This is the only bunch.
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Rose</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
Cecilia
Ah, the Cecilia. Did Miss Flora recommend it to you?
This flower is a lot of effort to care for. I hope that I've been doing it right, otherwise they won't last long.
But part of the Cecilia's charm is how precious and fragile each one is...
You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Cecilia</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!
What does Donna think?
You want my help? I don't know if I have the best taste in flowers... Why don't you go ask Miss <color=#00E1FFFF>Flora</color>, the shop owner?
I couldn't help but notice the flower on Miss Lisa's hat though — I think it's a <color=#00E1FFFF>Rose</color>.
I'll be back shortly.
What kind of flowers does Lisa like?
You want to know what flowers to get for Miss Lisa?
We're not particularly close, but she strikes me as a classy lady!
Hmm... Yep, it can only be the <color=#00E1FFFF>Cecilia</color>!
Yes
Dandelions? They actually sell dandelions?
They have a refreshing scent, similar to the one Jean wears. Thank you.
Yes
Huh? These flowers are saturated with Cryo energy. They could be very dangerous for me.
Don't you know what happens when Cryo meets Electro? *Tut-tut* You certainly haven't been doing your homework.

Meet me at the library after work and I will give you some training on elemental reactions. If you still find it hard to memorize... Maybe I'll have you give you a little taste of what it feels like to superconduct.
Yes
I can see you put a lot of thought into this, have you ever heard of the Witch of Purple Rose before?
I thought that after returning to Mondstadt I wouldn't have the chance to see fresh roses again.
This seems like a good sign.
Yes
Ooh la-la, such fine taste.
This rare flower is only found in Mondstadt's very highest mountains.
If only you had picked them for me with your own hands... They would have had twice the sentimental value.
No
Okay, time to get back to business. Donna, do you know why we're here?
Back to business? My business is selling flowers!
*sigh* Once again, we see a total lack of respect for literature...
<color=#00E1FFFF>The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies</color>. Ring a bell?
Oh! Ahh, yes, well, what happened was... was...
Oh no, what am I gonna do?
I... I lost the book.
A while back, I realized it was almost due and I was getting ready to bring it back to the library.
But I couldn't find it anywhere. I looked for days — but nothing.
It's like somebody stole it... It should have been there, on my bedside table. Right where I left it.
Uh-oh... Bet Lisa does some crazy things when she gets mad!
I heard that!
Eek!
Well, if it really was stolen, Donna's done nothing wrong.
The blame lies with the book thief.
And their punishment will be three— No, ten times worse than stealing my book.
Like Paimon said! Totally crazy!
How do we...
How do we find the lost book though?
Oh, don't worry about that. As long as I remain librarian, not a single book will go missing for good.
I put a unique elemental marker on each book. Our thief will have left a nice set of clues for us to follow.
When did Lisa start taking her job so seriously!? Paimon always thought she was a total slacker.
Hey sweetie, I've heard your elemental sensitivity is very strong... Why not see what you can do?
Elemental sensitivity? Oh! Paimon's got it!
{NICKNAME}, use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> to look for clues!
What happened?
This is our final call for the day.
Welcome...! Uh... c—couples are our specialty! Let me know what you'd like and I'll wrap them up nicely for you.
Ah yes... Now which book was it that has the line, "a date without flowers is a date without romance"?

dialogue.sit: Would you by any chance care for some flowers, milady?
No idea which book. Never even heard the line before.

dialogue.t: Why, it just so happens that I would, my kindest cutie.
No idea which book. Never even heard the line before.
Ugh, {NICKNAME}. Take. The. Hint.
Hehe, never mind, your ignorance is somehow rather adorable.
Since you're here, and Lisa is here, and this is a flower shop... You might as well get a bunch of flowers, right? It only makes sense.

Some flowers for Miss Lisa? What would you like?
(Pick a kind that Lisa will like)

Some flowers for Miss Lisa? What would you like?
(Pick a kind that Lisa will like)
*sigh* How could I lose it...
Looking at the elemental traces, it does seem likely that the book was stolen.
So Donna didn't do anything wrong after all.
It's not from the restricted section, so it's hardly a book worth stealing.
Whoever wanted this book so badly had a strange fixation indeed.
Hmm... so what do we do now?
The <color=#00E1FFFF>elemental traces</color> are very faint, but I can tell that the thief took it beyond the city walls.
You must see it too, right, {NICKNAME}?
Let's follow the trail and have a little look where our thief was headed, shall we?

quests.description: Librarian Lisa seems annoyed about her work…

quests.title: Lost Book

dialogue.t: It must be nearby.
Using <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color>, you can even detect <color=#00E1FFFF>magic</color>.
Follow the flow of <color=#00E1FFFF>magic</color> to find the book.
The thief lives inside <color=#00E1FFFF>ruins</color>? Mondstadt people do have some strange quirks.
Please do not jump to such a preposterous conclusion about the living habits of Mondstadt's residents.
This seems far more likely to be the work of some none-too-friendly troublemakers.
Stealing books is hardly the hilichurls' style.
All they would use books for is to keep their campfire going anyway.
This is more likely to be the <color=#00E1FFFF>Abyss Order's</color> doing. They do seem to have a way of slipping in and out of places like ghosts, after all.
Also... There is an elemental seal at the entrance. It looks like the result of an Abyss Mage's magic.
A seal? How are we gonna break it? Is this gonna turn into another huge ordeal?
Not to worry. If you think a little magic can keep me out, think again!
Why is that?
Come on.
Whoa...
So this is what Lisa's like when she's hard at work...
The Abyss Order?
It's like you can read my mind.
The Adventurers' Guild?
It's not unlike them, in the sense that they are known for darting around amongst underground ruins.
But Adventurers do not typically take others' belongings... Well, not from the living, anyway.
How did you find this place!? It's... so well hidden!
I have no interest in finding out where you little rascals hide yourselves away. But I do want my book back.
Tell me, how is it that you have the time to conceal your stronghold and apply a magic seal — but not to sign out a library book in the proper manner?
You have no respect whatsoever for other people's work.
...You— You just want... <color=#00E1FFFF>the book</color>?
I was unaware that anyone in Mondstadt was concerned with unearthing the secret hidden inside this book...
Who... Who are you?
The librarian. Although, I believe that should be quite clear already.
Return the book. This is an ultimatum.
Hmph. Since you insist on concealing your identity...
I have all the less reason to give you that book.
After all, it contains... the secret...
Huh!? Wh—What are you doing!? Such concentrated elemental power! P—Please don't—
*shrieking*
Hmph. Naughty boys who don't do what they're told need a little punishment to keep them in line.

dialogue.sit: You didn't let him finish speaking...

dialogue.t: *sigh* This is why I call it troublesome work.
We'll just need to find the book ourselves. It should be around here somewhere.
A LITTLE punishment!?
Lisa is so terrifying...
It's <color=#00E1FFFF>The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies</color>! Paimon remembers that name, is this the one you were looking for?
That's the one. It's a good thing it isn't damaged, otherwise...
Otherwise what? Are you telling me you have even more crazy punishments up your sleeve!?
Hehe. I would probably have needed to dish out a little taste of one of my potions in that case.
Ah!
Then again... As I said, it isn't from the restricted section. Which is the only reason I would let the average citizen borrow it in the first place.
And it doesn't appear to have any abnormal elemental properties, save for the markings I put on it.
Yeah... It seems like just an average storybook.

dialogue.sit: So why did the Abyss Order...

dialogue.t: (How mysterious. I'm so curious...)
As far as my duties as a librarian go, my troublesome work is finished.
Since this book has piqued your interest, why don't I let you borrow it?

dialogue.sit: Please don't punish me if I return it late...

dialogue.t: Please don't punish me if I return it late...
There's no time limit for you. I will register you as "custodian" rather than "borrower."
This is an exclusive privilege reserved for trusted citizens only.
Exclusive privilege? Why does Paimon feel this is just your sneaky way of offloading your troublesome work onto someone else?
Excuse me? Are you in some way dissatisfied with my work?

dialogue.sit: I will take extra special care of this book...

dialogue.t: I will take extra special care of this book...
Good. You are amenable to reason then. I do wish I could keep you by my side as my personal assistant...
My work here is done. I'm going back.
Don't forget to register at the library when you have a spare moment.
Ah, you've returned. The paperwork is done — you are now the custodian of this book.
Thank you Miss Lisa!
...But Paimon thinks we're forgetting something.
Look, over there on the shelf! Isn't that the <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color>?
And look how many copies there are!
Hehe... The <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color> is a serial publication. It is not part of the library's formal collection.
Oh...
Take one. Consider it your compensation for being Lisa's little helper today.
With you by my side, my troublesome work was a little less dull than usual.
Hmph! The Teyvat Travel Guide was just bait to get us to do a day's work!
I hadn't anticipated that a few routine returns inquiries would take us out of the city, let alone down into some underground ruins.
As compensation for dragging you into all this bother, take these souvenirs.
Wow, Lisa went and bought us some special souvenirs!
In fact, they were intended for our next outing, but... Never mind, we can discuss next time's activity when the time comes. I hope you are looking forward to it.
*yawn*
Remuneration!
You are a voracious one, aren't you?
The <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color> is on the bookcase next to you.
Have a look.
No need to return it.

quests.description: Many people forget to return the library books they’ve borrowed, leaving Lisa no choice but to chase them and retrieve the books. Marjorie and Sara have agreed to return the books they borrowed as soon as possible, but Donna’s seems to have been stolen. You decide to track the missing book down by following the trail left by an elemental marking Lisa made on it.
